back.description: Simulates pressing the system back button.

compare_ui_frames.description:
Reports whether the screen visibly changed between two captured frames.

Pure computation on base64 frames the caller already holds -- nothing is
captured here, so the caller keeps ownership of when to look. The verdict
rules (status/nav bar masking, the full-screen change ratio, the widened ROI
check for taps, and assuming "changed" when a frame cannot be decoded) are
the same ones the Validator uses, from artemis.utils.image_diff.

Returns a JSON string such as '{"changed": true}', or 'Error: ...'.

focus_and_clear_text.description:
Focuses on a UI element at coordinates and clears its text content.

'coordinates' is a list [x, y] to tap first to gain focus.

focus_and_input_text.description:
Focuses on a UI element at coordinates and inputs text.

'coordinates' is a list [x, y] to tap first to gain focus.
'clear_before_input' if True, clears all existing text before typing. If False, appends text at the end of existing content.
'text' supports multi-line content with '\n'.

get_ui_hierarchy.description: Retrieves the current UI elements hierarchy from the device.

launch_app.description: Launches an application by its Android package name with retries and smart polling.

list_devices.description:
Lists attached Android devices and their readiness, touching none of them.

Read-only discovery for callers that schedule work across machines (the plugin's device pool and
submission admission, G3/G28/G64). Enumeration is the runtime pool's own, so snapshot caching
and timeout behaviour stay in one place.

The result keeps **"could not ask adb"** distinct from **"adb answered: no devices"**:
`enumerated` is false only when the question itself failed. Collapsing those two would turn a
transient adb blip into an empty fleet, which is why `try_list_devices_async` exists upstream.

`include_lock_state` defaults to **false** because the answer costs 1-2 `dumpsys` calls per
device (Keyguard is not part of `adb devices`); ask for it only when you gate a dispatch on it.
Each device then carries `is_locked`: true locked, false unlocked, **null unknown** -- and
unknown is treated as not-admissible by the submission gate, so it must stay distinguishable
from false. Without the flag the key is simply absent, meaning "not asked", never "unlocked".

Returns a JSON string such as '{"enumerated": true, "devices": [{"serial": "emulator-5554",
"state": "device", "is_busy": false, "is_locked": null}]}'.

long_press_on.description:
Long presses on the screen at coordinates.

'coordinates' is a list [x, y].
'duration' is in milliseconds (default 1000).

open_link.description: Opens a URL or deep link on the device.

press_key.description: Presses a specific Android key event (e.g., KEYCODE_ENTER, KEYCODE_HOME).

stop_app.description: Force stops an application by its Android package name.

swipe.description:
Swipes from start coordinates to end coordinates.

'coordinates' is a list [start_x, start_y, end_x, end_y].
'duration' is in milliseconds (default 400).

Set duration >= 1000 to drag-and-drop. Drag slightly past the target
position to trigger reordering.

take_screenshot.description:
Takes a screenshot of the device screen.

Returns the screenshot as a base64 encoded JPEG string.

tap.description:
Taps on the screen at coordinates.

'coordinates' is a list [x, y].
'times' is the number of consecutive clicks (default 1).
'delay_ms' is the delay in milliseconds between consecutive clicks (default
100).
